last_episode_to_air.name: Episode 7
last_episode_to_air.overview: Defne, to forget Kadir, decides to leave Istanbul, while fate once again puts the two on the same path. The unexpected journey they embark on together brings their suppressed feelings back to the surface, while a new name entering between them causes Defne to confront an unexpected jealousy she never anticipated. Meanwhile, critical decisions at the company change all the balances, and Selma and Leyla's moves once again drive Defne and Kadir's love into a dead end. Where love, pride, and jealousy intertwine, the surprise developments will bring Defne and Kadir to the threshold of a confrontation they never expected.

name: Possible Love
overview: Defne, a woman in her thirties, is strong and composed, having built her career through hard work. One day, she realizes just how exhausted and isolated she has become; perhaps the time has come for love. However, two men who enter her life turn everything upside down. Caught between Kadir’s unsettling demeanor and Tolga’s games that shift the balance, Defne finds that nothing will ever be the same again.
